Sell-to-buy in the first two minutes after graduation is near zero, so nobody dumped early, and there's no airdrop-dump pattern.

But the brief also shows that 99.9% of early buying came from the top five buyers, with bundle share at 100% and 16 non-agent buyers in the first two minutes after graduation on roughly 3,000 SOL of buying. That is a classic operator pattern, and recent operator coins have been roughly break-even, not reliable winners. The recent 15-minute activity is real, but it is small relative to the early bundled flow, and the apparent demand could be the same operator's wallets cycling.

I don't see an honest case that demand here will persist for 30-60 minutes. I'd recommend skipping this coin.
